name: Viking® 3 Series 24" 4.6 Cu. Ft. Panel Ready Under the Counter Refrigerator
shortDescription: Keep your favorite refreshments close at hand. From chilled snacks to cold beverages, you have enough storage space to appease an army - or slumber party. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY*

images.label: Viking® 3 Series 24" 4.6 Cu. Ft. Panel Ready Under the Counter Refrigerator-1

features.text: Professional Features
4.6 cu. ft. capacity stores up to 95 cans (12 oz.)
Includes two cantilevered white-framed glass shelves (one half-width/one full-width) and one fixed position steel framed glass shelf
Half-width shelf allows for tall item storage
MaxStore bin stores loose items
Dynamic cooling technology delivers rapid cool down, frost-free operation, and temperature stability
Digital controls allow temperature selections from 34°F to 60°F
Door ajar and high/low temperature alerts
Arctic white LED theater-style lighting
Arctic white interior
Low profile, ADA compliant height
Accepts 3/4” or 5/8” custom panels or accessory door panel kits
Design Options
Reversible soft-close door allows for right or left swing
Choose of two accessory door panel kits for each unit
Professional Door Panel features the iconic Viking handle for true design integrity
Classic Door Panel features a slim handle that coordinates with any kitchen design
Accessories
